en.headline: Five Hong Kong universities in Asia’s top 10 as HKU retains first place
en.dek: QS Asia rankings place City University fourth and Chinese University fifth, with three local institutions in the top five for the first time in more than a decade.
body: Five Hong Kong universities ranked among Asia’s top 10 in the 2027 QS Asia University Rankings released on Tuesday, with the University of Hong Kong retaining the top spot.

City University of Hong Kong rose to fourth place and the Chinese University of Hong Kong to fifth, putting three local institutions in the top five for the first time in more than a decade. The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology tied for ninth.

Quacquarelli Symonds said all 11 ranked Hong Kong institutions were in Asia’s top 500 for the first time, attributing the results to rising international engagement and growing recognition among academics and employers.

On the mainland, Peking University held second place and Tsinghua University rose to third. City University said it ranked first in Asia on three indicators, including the proportion of staff with PhDs, international faculty and outbound exchange students.

zh.headline: QS亞洲大學排名港五校入十強 港大蟬聯榜首
zh.dek: 城大升至第四、中大第五，本港三間大學相隔逾十年再同時位列亞洲五強。
body: 國際高等教育資訊機構Quacquarelli Symonds周二公布2027年QS亞洲大學排名，香港有五所大學蹉身亞洲十強，香港大學蟬聯榜首。
城市大學升至第四位，中文大學升至第五位，本港三間大學相隔逾十年再同時位列亞洲五強。理工大學與科技大學並列第九。
QS表示，本港11所上榜院校首次全部進入亞洲500強，歸因於國際參與度上升以及學術界與僱主認受度提高。
內地方面，北京大學保持第二，清華大學升至第三。城大表示在三項指標上亞洲排名第一，包括擁有博士學位教員比例、國際教員及出境交換生比例。
